summary: The three most important visible problems are: (1) cross_legged has a conspicuous angular collapse of the skirt across the lap, with cloth strips appearing to intersect the crossed thighs; (2) the skirt and petticoat retain a broad, rigid shell around the hips in sit_chair, jump_tuck, and lie_back_elbows, an expected limitation of these physics-disabled previews but still visible; (3) high_kick has an abrupt cloth-to-thigh junction around the raised leg that reads as a small intersection. The body generally holds its proportions and joint volume well at this sheet scale; I see no clearly broken limbs, mesh explosions, or unequivocal severe shoulder or forearm twists. Most other overlaps are consistent with ordinary occlusion. Clip ratings cover only the supplied samples: small pops between unshown frames cannot be assessed, and a change between widely separated samples is not sufficient evidence of a pop.

items.name: sit_chair
items.location: Lap and skirt around the seated hips, especially in the 3/4 view
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat form a stiff canopy over the lap with a projecting rear hem, consistent with absent cloth physics, while the visible thighs and knees retain reasonable volume.

items.name: cross_legged
items.location: Center of the lap and inner thighs, in both views
items.issue: The skirt collapses into conspicuous angular bands across the crossed legs, with green outer cloth appearing to cut into the thigh area and the pink underskirt remaining a rigid bowl beneath it.

items.name: deep_lunge
items.location: Skirt over the forward thigh and between the bent legs
items.issue: The lifted front skirt and underskirt preserve a stiff arch across the bent legs instead of settling around them, although no deep body penetration is clearly resolved at this scale.

items.name: jump_tuck
items.location: Skirt and petticoat surrounding the tucked thighs
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat lift together as a broad, nearly planar shell around the tucked legs, an evident physics-disabled cloth limitation without a clearly visible major body intersection.

items.name: high_kick
items.location: Raised thigh where it meets the lifted skirt, especially in the front view
items.issue: The raised thigh meets an abruptly folded skirt edge that appears to cut slightly into the leg, while the petticoat stays broadly propped open around the kick.

items.name: hug_self
items.issue: The sleeve volumes merge into a flattened band across the chest with a pinched central overlap, although the underlying arms are too concealed to establish a body deformation problem.

items.name: lie_back_elbows
items.location: Skirt over the extended thighs and around the reclining hips
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat remain a raised, bowl-like shell over the extended legs instead of settling onto them, which is conspicuous but consistent with the lack of cloth simulation.

items.name: sit_stand
items.location: Lap and rear skirt during the seated hold, in both views
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat hold a stiff, open canopy over the seated thighs with a projecting rear panel, expected without cloth physics, and the supplied samples show no unequivocal deformation pop.

items.name: spin
items.location: Flared skirt and petticoat around the hips
items.issue: The flared skirt retains an unusually uniform disk-like shape through the rotation, consistent with driven cloth bones without simulation, but the adjacent samples at 5 and 6 show no obvious pop or tearing.
